results.name: Built screen matches design B
results.detail: Compared at 1440x900 in the browser pane and in the Tauri window: top bar (cursive C, breadcrumb, Proofread, auto-fixed, gray badge, version stepper), centered serif column, margin notes, right card, lone record button.

results.name: Text contrast >= 4.5:1 on the texture
results.detail: Body 13.1:1, margin notes 10.7:1, live dictation paragraph 5.7:1 (was 4.3:1, darkened).

results.name: 1100px wide: both columns, no horizontal scroll
results.detail: scrollWidth == innerWidth at 1100px; card right edge at 1072px.

results.name: Save hidden with 1 pending, shown with 0
results.detail: Resolved 4 of 5: Save hidden, badge 1. Resolved last: badge hidden, Save shown; Save made v4.

results.name: Record button: idle red circle, recording stop + spinning ring
results.detail: Toggles states; timer counts under the button and clears on stop.

results.name: Pending dropdown jumps to issue with card ready
results.detail: Badge opens a list of 5; clicking the 4th scrolls to it, marches the outline and opens the Rephrase card.

results.name: Hover preview, Esc restore, 1-5 pick, More without repeats
results.detail: Hover showed 'paramount' in place, Esc restored 'very important'; key 1 applied; 3x More gave 5 distinct options.

results.name: The breadcrumb shows no Speech or Blog tag.
results.detail: Preview: the breadcrumb reads 'Library / Remarks for the Riverside Library Opening' with no kind element.

results.name: bun run dev opens the app window on macOS
results.detail: Window opens on the library; captured the window.

results.name: Creating a document writes its folder; reopening lists it
results.detail: Rust test create_open_save_rename_delete: folder with meta.json is written and list_docs returns it. First run seeded ~/Cader (test library) and a relaunch of the built .app listed it. In-UI create/rename/delete clicked through in the browser preview (in-memory stand-in); not clicked in the native window.

results.name: Webview cannot read files outside Cader's commands
results.detail: No fs plugin; capability grants core:default and window dragging only; CSP default-src 'self'. Ids are validated: test ids_cannot_escape_the_library refuses ../etc, a/b, .trash.

results.name: No outbound network during a session
results.detail: Partial: lsof showed 0 inet sockets in the Cader process while using the library and editor. Dictation and models are not built yet, so the proxy check for a dictation and review session reruns with S-3 and S-4.

results.name: Builds a macOS .app
results.detail: bun run build: src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Cader.app, 8.3 MB; it launches.

results.name: Rust unit tests
results.detail: cargo test: 3 passed.

results.name: The library shows one New button and no Speech or Blog tag; New opens an "Untitled" document.
results.detail: Preview: the library has one New button and rows show title, edited time and status only (0 kind tags). New opened a document titled 'Untitled' with the title selected.

results.name: 60 s passage lands within 5 s of stopping
results.detail: 54.6 s spoken clip (macOS say) transcribed in 2.0 s on an M2 Max with Large v3 Turbo + Metal, model already loaded (the app loads it while recording). Not timed on an M1. Accuracy: one slip, patience -> patients.

results.name: Stopping mid-sentence inserts the partial text
results.detail: Whatever was captured is trimmed by VAD and transcribed; insertion at the caret checked in the UI preview (text joined after 'volunteers' with a space).

results.name: No model yet: record starts the download
results.detail: start_recording returns false and starts a one-time download with progress events and SHA-256 check; the UI shows 'Downloading speech model n%'. The download code path was not run end to end; the model was fetched with curl to the same folder and its SHA-256 matched.

results.name: Raw transcript saved next to the document
results.detail: stop_recording writes <doc>/transcripts/<ms>.txt. Code path covered by review, not by a native-window run.

results.name: Works without the Handy app
results.detail: whisper-rs (Metal) and Silero VAD run in-process; Handy is not installed or called.

results.name: Microphone permission
results.detail: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is in the built Cader.app. Denial is detected as 1.5 s of pure silence and shows 'Open Settings'. The native permission prompt was not triggered in testing.

results.name: Rust tests
results.detail: cargo test: 5 passed (resample, VAD silence trim, library); ignored transcription test passed with the real model.

results.name: First run downloads the models once; second run starts offline
results.detail: Shared downloader (fetch.rs) streams to .part, checks SHA-256, renames; present files are skipped. All 4 files (CoEdIT encoder/decoder/tokenizer, Qwen GGUF) downloaded and hash-verified, 1.94 GB total. Not exercised through the in-app download button.

results.name: correct() on a 20 word sentence with three errors returns it fixed in under 1.5 s
results.detail: 0.19 s on M2 Max (no M1 here): 'who has ... more then there time' -> 'who have ... more than their time', exact. Instruction switched to 'Fix grammar in this sentence' after 'Fix grammatical errors' missed then/than. A second test sentence came back in 0.24 s with 2 of 3 fixes ('goes' kept), so CoEdIT is not perfect.

results.name: Cancelling a running request frees it within 200 ms
results.detail: Qwen generation cancelled mid-stream returned in 6 ms. A newer request for the same key supersedes the old one (unit test).

results.name: rephrase/substitute/alternatives return de-duplicated JSON options
results.detail: Qwen2.5-1.5B Q4_K_M on Metal: 5 distinct substitutes for 'very important' with notes in 0.78-1.09 s, including model load warm path. Echoes, repeats and excluded options are dropped.

results.name: Whisper, ONNX and llama.cpp live in one binary and exit cleanly
results.detail: Full suite 11/11 passed with all three models loaded in one process. Models are freed on app exit to avoid a ggml Metal teardown assert.

results.name: About screen states the CoEdIT CC-BY-NC licence
results.detail: Native macOS About panel credits list all three models and licences. Builds and launches; panel not visually checked because this shell has no Accessibility access to click the menu.

results.name: A paragraph with five planted errors shows five issue cards
results.detail: Preview: 'So um, the people who has worked on the the renovaton gave more then their time' gives 5 notes (Filler word, Grammar has->have, Repeated word, Commonly confused then->than, Missing end punctuation) plus 1 auto-fix (renovaton). Real CoEdIT on 4 more planted sentences: every error found with a reason (dont->doesn't, were->where, is->are, have removed, there->their, despite of, nine,).

results.name: Accept all leaves no issue cards and the text matches the expected corrected text
results.detail: After Accept all: 'I think the people who have worked here are great and kind. So the people gave more than their time.' 0 notes, pending badge hidden, Save shown. Unit test: applying every edit last-first reproduces the model's sentence exactly.

results.name: Editing one sentence triggers one model call, not a full re-check
results.detail: Model call counter went 2 -> 3 after editing the first of two sentences. The sentence under the caret waits until the caret leaves it.

results.name: Auto-fixes are listed and can be undone; Ignore hides an issue for this version
results.detail: '1 auto-fixed' opens a list; Undo restores 'renovaton' and does not re-flag it. Ignore removes the note and lowers the count.

results.name: Real model returns one clean sentence per call
results.detail: The int8 decoder repeated the tail of unpunctuated sentences ('...their time. gave more then their time.'). Fixed with a no-repeat-3-gram rule and by keeping as many sentences as went in. 14/14 Rust tests pass with all models loaded.

results.name: Selecting "very big" and pressing Substitute offers words like "enormous" or "immense"
results.detail: Real Qwen, first batch in ~1.5 s: enormous, vast, immense, huge, gigantic, each with a short note. In the preview, Cmd+E on the selection fills the card with 5 options.

results.name: Hover preview then Esc leaves the text unchanged
results.detail: Hover put 'enormous' in place and showed its note in the hint; Esc restored 'The hall was very big and full of light.' and closed the card.

results.name: Three presses of More return no duplicate options
results.detail: Real Qwen: 4 batches, 19-20 options, no repeats (enforced while sampling: excluded words are banned or discouraged, 3 extra items asked, repeats filtered). More batches take ~2.5-3 s. Later batches drift (e.g. 'unprecedented'). Preview: 12 distinct after 3 Mores.

results.name: Rephrase returns 3 rewrites that fit the sentence
results.detail: 'keeping a promise that was made' -> kept our word / kept our promise / kept our commitment; 'very important' -> of great significance / of utmost importance. Rewrites that run into the next words are trimmed. Idioms are weak: 'their actual blood, sweat and tears' often echoes or drifts (model limit).

results.name: 1-5 picks, Cmd+R / Cmd+E switch, a newer request supersedes the old one
results.detail: Key 3 applied 'vast'. Switching tabs mid-request cancels the stale one and starts the new tab.

results.name: A 15 word sentence shows 3 alternatives whose meaning matches (10 sentences by hand)
results.detail: Qwen2.5-14B: 9 of 10 test sentences gave 3 alternatives that all keep the meaning; the 10th had one that drifted. About 6 s per batch, first one in about 2.5 s, streamed.

results.name: More twice yields 9 distinct alternatives
results.detail: qwen_sentence_alternatives: 9 distinct of 9.

results.name: Applied alternative appears in the version history diff
results.detail: Preview: applied an alternative, saved v5; the Versions panel lists 'Alternative: So let me begin ... -> Let me begin, simply, by thanking ...' and the diff marks the new words.

results.name: Three review passes produce three versions with correct change lists
results.detail: versions::three_passes_then_restore passes; in the preview each Save added a version whose panel entry lists that review's changes.

results.name: Restoring v1 creates v4 equal to v1
results.detail: Preview: with v1, v2 saved and an unsaved edit, Restore as v4 saved the draft as v3 and v4's text equals v1. Backend test passes too.

results.name: Killing the app mid-review and reopening restores the unsaved text
results.detail: Autosave writes text.md atomically 400 ms after each change and on close; open_doc reads it back as a draft (library tests pass). Not driven by killing the native window.

results.name: With 1 pending suggestion, Save is not shown.
results.detail: Preview: after Proofread with 5 pending, Save is hidden; with 0 it shows.

results.name: Save with 0 pending creates a new version and leaves no marks in the text.
results.detail: Preview: Save made v1 with 0 marks and 0 margin notes; badge, Proofread and auto-fixed hidden; Export and Request review shown.

results.name: Request review after Save shows new suggestions and keeps the saved version unchanged in history.
results.detail: Preview: Request review moved to v2 and showed 2 suggestions; v1 in the Versions panel is unchanged.

results.name: Markdown export of the latest saved version matches its text exactly.
results.detail: versions test: the exported .md equals the saved text byte for byte (and a second export gets ' (2)'). Preview stand-in matched too.

results.name: A saved document made with New lists Reading view and PDF in its Export menu.
results.detail: Preview: New, typed a paragraph, Save; Export lists Copy text, Markdown, Plain text, Reading view and PDF, and Cmd+Shift+R opens the reading view on it.
